{{Otheruses|Three Moons}}
The '''Three Moons''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Around [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">On the date of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] eleventh birthday (30.9 BBY), Kitster records a message saying that Rarta Dal has conditionally offered him a job, in ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''.</ref> it was owned by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] inhabitant of Mos Espa named [[Rarta Dal]]. She hired only one employee, a steward named [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Three Moons was mentioned twice in passing in ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'', a standalone novel written by [[Troy Denning]] and published by [[Del Rey]].
